description: This file defines a UtilityScript class that manages injected script utilities, including handling built-in browser functions, evaluating expressions, and serializing values. It also imports serializers and manages environment-specific built-ins.

classes.name: UtilityScript
classes.description: A class providing utility functions for injected scripts, including evaluation, serialization, and environment management.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the global context, optionally as a function, with provided arguments and handles.

methods.name: jsonValue
methods.description: Serializes a value into a JSON-compatible format, with special handling for undefined.

methods.name: _promiseAwareJsonValueNoThrow
methods.description: Serializes a value, awaiting if it's a Promise, with error handling.
